bio.text: Robert Garcia was elected in November 2022 to represent California's 42nd Congressional District, which includes Long Beach and Southeast Los Angeles, and is the ranking member of the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee.
He served on the Long Beach City Council from 2009 to 2014 and as the city's mayor from 2014 to 2022.
He was born in Lima, Peru, in 1977, and earned a bachelor's degree and an Ed.D. from California State University, Long Beach, and a master's degree from the University of Southern California.
He worked as a professor of public policy and communications and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
